meta.title: Session Modes & Injection
meta.description: Session modes & injection: the session-mode row (each mode's persona, tool and policy lists, switches; the per-session scope lives inside it), the subagent takeover row, the injection channel, and tool guidance (localized copy, usage groups) — installed in one bundle. The row list belongs to the shipped preset a session rides on; this bundle declares no preset of its own.
